nodes.title: Layout Boxes Pixaroma (2. draw where each thing goes)

boxes.desc: a shiny red apple with a short brown stem and one small green leaf, a bright window highlight on its skin
a white ceramic cup of cappuccino on a matching saucer, a leaf-shaped latte art pattern in the pale brown foam and a small silver spoon resting on the saucer
a small stack of two old hardcover books with plain worn brown and sage green cloth covers, plain spines and yellowed page edges

nodes.title: Prompt Pixaroma (3. the scene, naming each box)

promptState.text: A food and drink still-life photograph of a rustic wooden table by a window, with <obj_1> on the left, <obj_2> in the middle and <obj_3> on the right. The table is weathered pale oak with fine grain and a few small knife marks, and behind it a white-painted window frame and a plain cream plaster wall fall softly out of focus. Clear morning daylight from the window at camera-left falls across the table from the side, giving each object a soft shadow to the right and a bright highlight along its left edge. Shot at table height from slightly above, with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, all three objects sharp. A calm palette of warm oak, cream and soft sage green, with the red apple as the one strong accent. True-to-life colour, gentle contrast, the fine grain of 35mm colour film.

{"version":1,"content":"

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 FLUX 3 needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer, the first version with FLUX 3. On an older ComfyUI, Load CLIP has no flux3 type and some nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 FLUX 3 needs a free approval first (one time only)

Black Forest Labs keeps the FLUX 3 files behind a short approval on Hugging Face. Until you do it, every FLUX 3 download link below answers "Access to model ... is restricted ... Please log in".

  1. Log in to Hugging Face (a free account).
  2. Open the FLUX 3 model page with the button below and click Agree and access repository. Access is given at once.
  3. Now the download links below work, in the same browser.

FLUX 3 Klein on Hugging Face 

 Downloading with ComfyUI-Manager or a script needs a Hugging Face token as well (hf auth login). In the browser, being logged in is enough.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors5.83 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/flux3

Create the flux3 folder if it does not exist.

Take the file WITHOUT base in its name: that is the distilled (fast) model these workflows use. The files with base in the name are the base model, made for training LoRAs: it needs CFG 3.5 and 25 to 50 steps, and at the settings here (15 or 16 steps, CFG 1) its pictures come out smeared and broken.

Already have flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot.safetensors? That is the same file under its first name (ComfyUI's own template used it at launch). Pick it in this node instead of downloading it again.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors4.86 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download flux2-vae.safetensors336 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

The same file as Flux 2 Klein: if you have it, skip this one.

 Google Gemini Free Prompting Gem

Type the scene into the Gem and it writes the long prompt FLUX 3 works best with. Paste it into 3. the scene, naming each box, then add each box's tag where that thing is described: <obj_1>, <obj_2> and so on.

Tip: start your message with write the prompt: so Gemini writes a prompt and does not try to make the picture itself. It is free with a Google account.

FLUX 3 Prompt Writer 

 License

FLUX 3 Image Klein is released under the FLUX Kommunity License. You may use the pictures commercially only while your yearly revenue (all the money coming in, before costs), together with any company you belong to, is under US$5 million. Read it before you use the model for paid work.

FLUX 3 Klein model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.219). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Draw boxes to say WHERE each thing goes, and FLUX 3 puts each one in its box. Good for a still life or a product shot with several items.

 Steps

  1. Pick the picture size on Sizes Pixaroma: the box canvas takes the same shape.
  2. On Layout Boxes Pixaroma, move or resize the boxes, or draw new ones, and write in each box's row what is in it.
  3. In Prompt Pixaroma, describe the scene and name each box by its tag: <obj_1>, <obj_2>, <obj_3>, the numbers on the boxes.
  4. Leave the seed on F to repeat a picture, or switch it to R for a new one every Run.
  5. Press Run. Show Text Pixaroma shows the prompt with the box table at the end.

 Writing the boxes and the scene

  • Give each box one full description: a white ceramic cup of cappuccino on a matching saucer, a leaf-shaped latte art pattern in the foam. Colours go in the words: the box colour on the canvas is only for you.
  • The prompt describes the whole picture: the kind of photo, the place, the light, the camera. Name each box once where it belongs: with <obj_1> on the left, <obj_2> in the middle and <obj_3> on the right.
  • Boxes are guides, not cut-outs: the object fills its box roughly, with its own shadow and shape.
  • Books, signs and packets in a box get made-up letters unless you give the words or call them plain. That is why the demo's books are closed, with plain covers.

 Good to know

  • Tested with 3 boxes on a still life: every object in its box on 4 of 4 seeds.
  • The prompt upsampler (workflow 3) is left out here: the boxes already are the description, and with it first one of our 4 test seeds swapped two objects.
  • The boxes are stored as parts of the canvas, so they stay in place when you pick another size. A different SHAPE (portrait instead of landscape) stretches them with the canvas: check them after you change the shape.
  • ComfyUI also has its own box node, Create Bounding Boxes, but its canvas only shows in Nodes 2.0. Layout Boxes Pixaroma works in both looks and gives FLUX 3 exactly the same table.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (FLUX 3 Klein, distilled) - The image model, FLUX 3 Image Klein from Black Forest Labs, the distilled version (no base in the file name): 15 steps, CFG 1. It makes a picture from words AND changes a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 4B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something FLUX 3 understands. The type must be flux3.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2 VAE) - Turns the finished render into a picture. FLUX 3 uses the same VAE as Flux 2.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Layout Boxes Pixaroma (2. draw where each thing goes) - The layout canvas, the shape of your picture. Each box is one thing in the picture, with a number and a short description. Drag a box to move it, drag its corner to resize it, draw a new one for a new thing; the big-view button opens it larger. Its width and height come from Sizes Pixaroma, so the canvas always has the picture's shape.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (3. the scene, naming each box) - The whole scene: the kind of photo, the place, the light and the camera. Each box is named by its tag: <obj_1> is box 1, <obj_2> box 2, and so on.
  • Sizes Pixaroma (1. picture size) - The picture size. The demo is 1344 x 768. It also sets the shape of the box canvas, so the boxes always match the picture.
  • Seed Pixaroma (4. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same picture every Run, R (random) a new one each Run. The demo uses seed 1.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • FLUX.3 Layout Prompt (adds the boxes to the prompt) - Adds the boxes to your prompt as a small table: where each box is and what is in it. FLUX 3 reads that table and puts each thing in its box.
  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. FLUX 3 distilled runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (blank canvas) - The blank canvas the picture is painted on, at the size it receives.
  • KSampler (15 steps) - The render: 15 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple. Black Forest Labs' own workflow uses 16 steps. In our tests 8 steps gave nearly the same picture in about half the time; more than 16 steps made skin smoother and more waxy.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the picture) - Saves each picture as PNG into ComfyUI/output/Flux 3 Klein Layout and shows it on the node.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Show Text Pixaroma (the prompt FLUX 3 gets) - Shows the prompt FLUX 3 actually gets: your scene, then the table of boxes at the end (each with its position, 0 to 1000 across and down, and its description).
  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

SizeTime
1344 x 768 (the demo)about 3 s
Full HD, 1920 x 1088about 5 s
2K, 2560 x 1440about 9 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (FLUX 3 and its text encoder, about 11 GB together), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
